title: Member closure
text: Run-bound QA counts and item closure debt are separate populations. Settlement diagnostics reuse current canonical membership and completion checks, name requirement, phase and target, distinguish independent blockers from atomic siblings and other-target deferrals, and never execute close-out during a read. Zero run-bound QA cannot establish that member closure or finalization effects have finished. A run that settles on its own target sets aside a member owing another environment's acceptance: it stamps deployed_to, then sends the member's claim holder (or the project's steering seat) one notice naming each owed requirement, its environment and how to run it. The fleet report row reads `delivered to ENV; owes #N on ENV` once that run succeeded, never `delivering in RUN`. Mid-run close-out and the implemented gate summary read the done write's own terminal-settlement check, so the summary cannot read satisfied while done refuses; accepted run copies of a post-deploy source settle the item's own verdictless capture on it. Each member closes as the item QA walk accepts it. A refused close-out wakes the owner with the refusal headline and each blocking record line, and retries by itself when that record settles (verdict, waiver, supersession, plan withdrawal, plan execution end); a new refusal reason wakes the owner again.
